notes.title: The Dark Delivers Demo is live
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that the demo for The Dark Delivers is now live. The basement office of Postal Sector 7 is open to anyone brave enough to work the night shift.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534399/d9f725c9a7210963251340a380cdc5b6d2308c1d.jpg[/img]

If you come across any bugs or have feedback to share, we’d love to hear from you. Please join the JaB Arcade Discord server and let us know. Your input will help us make the game even better.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/TVny644Y8V]Discord Server Invite Link[/url]
